crossRefs.note: Saul saw and knew that Yahweh was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Michal
people.line: Daughter of Saul; wife of David.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
translations.bsb: Now Saul’s daughter Michal loved David, and when this was reported to Saul, it pleased him.
translations.kjv: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
translations.asv: And Michal, Saul's daughter, loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
